title: CSV rerun pending publish destination guard
summary: Prevent CSV rerun pending-publish manifests from reusing an existing server_out destination and add a backend repair candidate for trusted CSV rerun duplicates.
reason: Backend autonomy health blocked launch because a CSV rerun parked payload kept the original final-library server_out while the parked local payload was suffixed, creating duplicate pending-publish destinations.
behavior_before: CSV rerun pending-publish and backend rerun promotion could suffix the parked local payload while leaving server_out pointed at an existing pending-publish destination, making the pending manifest set untrusted.
behavior_after: CSV rerun pending-publish and backend rerun promotion reserve existing pending-publish server_out destinations before manifest creation, and repair/reconcile can propose and apply a validated manifest-only repair for trusted CSV rerun duplicate rows.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-ContractSchemaChecks.ps1 static contract checks for CSV rerun pending server_out guards
manual_validation: Ran backend launch preflight after live repair; launch blocker cleared with can_request_start=true and overall_status=review.

Ran backend recovery-plan, repair-manifest-dry-run, and repair-manifest-apply against the live Paprika CSV rerun duplicate manifest; repaired server_out to a rerun-suffixed server destination and verified no duplicate pending-publish server_out remains.

Ran the priority CSV E:\Videos\Scratch\AuditReports\audit_summary_20260629_211102.priority.csv through the backend CSV rerun start route with scope.first_n=3, destination_mode=pending_publish, collision_policy=suffix, execution_mode=one_at_a_time; rerun batch rerun_20260702_142144_944753fe completed success=3 review=0 pending_publish=3 published=0 failed=0 pipeline_exit_failures=0.

Verified the three proof-run pending-publish manifests for Paprika (2006), Delicatessen (1991), and Cars (2006): parked payloads exist, output_size matches the local payload size, and the full PendingServerPush manifest set has duplicate server_out count 0.

Queried GET /api/launch/preflight after the proof run; CSV rerun preflight returned ready with 7 ready checks, and pipeline preflight returned review with 14 ready checks, 1 review check, 0 blocked checks, autonomy evidence overall_status=review and can_start_new_work=yes.
Ran .\ops\pipeline\runtime\PowerShell-7.6.0-win-x64\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\ops\pipeline\tests\Unit\Invoke-ContractSchemaChecks.ps1; contract schema checks passed.
Ran change-control validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage; coverage validation passed.
rollback_plan: Revert the changed Python and PowerShell files in this packet. For the live manifest repair, restore the backed-up manifest from E:\Videos\Scratch\State\RepairReconcileBackups\repair-reconcile-20260702T180231Z-03b8d700 if the operator intentionally wants the previous duplicate state back for diagnosis.
